text:
Frank C.: fyi customer acme-inc just escalated — their canary rollout rlt_7a9f is showing 'In progress' for >2h and the health chart is blank. They also reported intermittent 502s hitting the inference API during the window. ticket #CS-9132
Alice M.: ack. can you paste the org + rollout id and any screenshots?
Frank C.: org=acme-inc, rollout=rlt_7a9f. screenshot: link (private). Timeline shows no status updates after 11:58 UTC. customer says console shows 0/3 healthy but requests still routed.
metrics-bot: metrics ingestion: rlt_7a9f last point 2025-11-03T11:58:12Z; subsequent flush attempts returned 204.
Bob T.: I'm on it. initial hypothesis: status-sync service might have fallen behind and the UI health-chart query is hitting a stale index. Erin, can you check status-sync and kafka consumer lag?
Erin S.: checking now — consumer lag on topic rollout-status is high (~42k), consumer group status-sync-consumer shows steady retries. Pulling logs.
Dave L.: can we reproduce locally? any API error traces from proxy? Frank, do we have sample request ids from the customer?
Frank C.: customer provided a sample trace id: trace-0a3b. Also they sent a snippet of the UI network call: GET /api/console/rollouts/rlt_7a9f/health -> 200 but payload "progress":0, "status":"in_progress".
Alice M.: copying the trace id into support ticket. setting priority to p1 due to customer impact.
Bob T.: logs from status-sync:
```
2025-11-03T11:59:04Z status-sync ERROR partition=12 commit failed: kafka.ErrOutOfRange
2025-11-03T12:00:12Z status-sync WARN consumer lag=42120 group=status-sync-consumer
2025-11-03T12:05:00Z status-sync INFO reconciler stalled for rollout rlt_7a9f
```
Erin S.: also seeing repeated 429s from the topology service when status-sync tries to fetch latest endpoint metadata — might be cascading.
Dave L.: that could explain requests being routed to old variant. Carol, is there any recent deploy or change to rollout-state indexing?
Carol P.: no deploy to rollout-indexer in last 24h. we did push an autoscaling tweak to the topology service around 10:50 UTC in eu-west that briefly increased CPU. Could be related.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout rlt_7a9f was created at 2025-11-03T11:40:22Z
Bob T.: repro steps I'm running: 1) create test rollout with small replica set 2) intentionally delay status-sync consumer (pause) 3) hit console health endpoint -> confirm chart stays 'in progress' and metrics missing.
Alice M.: customer is asking for ETA. any estimate?
Erin S.: if we can restart the status-sync consumer and clear the kafka error partitions, we might see progress within ~10-15m. attempting restart now.
Bob T.: quick mitigation — toggle fallback routing to force direct status fetch from runtime: POST /api/internal/rollouts/rlt_7a9f/force-refresh (internal only). I'm going to run it and post results.
Bob T.: ran force-refresh -> response 202. UI started polling, got a new payload: {"status":"in_progress","progress":26}. Chart began updating.
Frank C.: customer confirmed they can now see progress on the chart and errors dropped. They've asked for root cause and prevention.
Dave L.: root cause draft: status-sync consumer hit kafka out-of-range/retention gap causing consumer group to stall; while stalled, topology service rate-limited status-sync fetches leading to delayed endpoint metadata and stale health views.
Carol P.: action items: 1) increase monitoring alert for consumer lag on rollout-status (threshold 10k) 2) add automated consumer restart play when ErrOutOfRange occurs 3) add UI indicator when health data is older than 5m -> show warning instead of stuck 'in progress' 4) postmortem with acme-inc.
Alice M.: I've filed follow-up ticket ENG-ROLL-2045 for the fixes and assigned to Bob/Erin/Dave. Notifying customer with workaround steps and timeline.
Frank C.: shared workaround: force-refresh endpoint + restart status-sync consumer. Customer happy for now, will monitor.
Bob T.: adding unit test around kafka offset handling and a small fix to detect retention gaps earlier. will PR shortly.
Erin S.: closing the immediate oncall loop, will keep watching consumer lag metrics.
Carol P.: scheduling a short eng/product sync tomorrow to discuss UI change.
Frank C.: thanks team :pray: updating ticket #CS-9132 that issue resolved with workaround and ENG follow-up.
metrics-bot: alert resolved: rollout-status consumer lag dropped below 5k at 2025-11-03T12:27:41Z
Alice M.: nice work. marking thread resolved unless new reports come in. :thumbsup:
